stages.title: PERSPECTIVE MAP, STAKES AND ESSENTIAL VOCABULARY

pills.text: PERSPECTIVE MAP, STAKES AND ESSENTIAL VOCABULARY
CENTRAL FOCUS
[1] GAUBA PRESENTS RIVAL PERSPECTIVES ON JUSTICE RATHER THAN
[2] RAWLS, NOZICK, MARXISM, SOCIALISM, ANARCHISM, FEMINISM AND COMMUNITARIANISM

sequence: CENTRAL FOCUS
Perspective Map, Stakes and Essential Vocabulary
[1] Gauba presents rival perspectives on justice rather than one settled formula.
[2] Rawls, Nozick, Marxism, socialism, anarchism, feminism and communitarianism differ.
[3] Every doctrine identifies a standard, an object, an institution and a remedy.

stages.title: THE SIX-AXIS COMPARATIVE MATRIX

pills.text: THE SIX-AXIS COMPARATIVE MATRIX
CENTRAL FOCUS
[1] RULE AXIS
PATTERNED FAIRNESS, HISTORICAL ENTITLEMENT OR ANTI-DOMINATION.
[2] STATE AXIS
REDISTRIBUTIVE AUTHORITY, MINIMAL PROTECTION OR DECENTRALISATION.
[3] PROPERTY AXIS
PRIMARY GOODS, TITLE HISTORY OR PRODUCTIVE CONTROL.

sequence: CENTRAL FOCUS
The Six-Axis Comparative Matrix
[1] Rule axis: patterned fairness, historical entitlement or anti-domination.
[2] State axis: redistributive authority, minimal protection or decentralisation.
[3] Property axis: primary goods, title history or productive control.

groups.heading: MODEL / STANDARD

items: [3] Property axis: primary goods, title history or productive control.
